I labeled the 'Software Development' heading phrase as software-engineering. It is uncertain because it works as a category label for the language list.
I did not add ai-ml for 'AI & LLM Engineering', because llms is the named skill there.
I mapped 'API Architecture' to api-design through its taxonomy alias. It is uncertain because it sits in a category heading.
'Google Cloud' maps to gcp.
Gemini is listed as an example of an AI coding assistant. I mapped it to the gemini id, which is uncertain because that entry covers the model family.
I assigned no alternative_group. In 'Gemini or Windsurf', Windsurf is unmapped, so the group would have only one taxonomy skill. I did not treat 'SQL/BigQuery' as alternatives.
Git and GitHub collapse into git.
Google Docs automation is left unmapped rather than forced to workflow-automation.
Seniority rests on '2+ years', which is on the junior/mid boundary under the guide (0–2 junior). 'Position Type Experienced' is not a level signal.
